# Balanced crypto-cluster rules — baseline vs new (Strategy Logic V2)

*Generated by `scripts/eval_cluster_mix.py` · data through **2026-10-10** · Balanced profile · walk-forward gated replay, 3 optimiser seeds (7, 11, 23; 7 = production) · cells are **total return / max drawdown / Sharpe**.*

## Question

The BTC parent cluster — BTC · MSTR · MSTU · ETH — trades **one** signal (the four sleeves enter and exit together on ~98 % of days). Two allocator questions follow, both answered here for the **Balanced** profile under V2:

1. **How should the cluster's weight be divided?** The anchor × priority tilt divided it erratically (one day 29 % of the book in BTC, another 25 % in ETH, the weakest sleeve).
2. **Should the cluster be allowed to grow after entry?** V2's adds-only pin freezes a held sleeve at its entry weight unless its target rises by ≥ 8 pp.

## The rules

Both in `overall_core`, V2 only, **Balanced only**:

* **Fixed split** (`CLUSTER_MIX_BALANCED`): the cluster is sized as before (tilt → per-sleeve caps → 30 % parent-cluster cap), then its combined weight is divided **MSTR 45 %** · **MSTU 30 %** · **BTC 20 %** · **ETH 5 %**, renormalised over the members funded and held to the per-sleeve caps (a full 30 % cluster is MSTR 13.5 % ≤ 18 %, MSTU 9 % ≤ 10 %, BTC 6 %, ETH 1.5 %). Applied to the tilt target before the adds-only pin: fresh entries are sized at the split.
* **Crypto cluster may add** (`ADDS_ONLY_CLUSTER_BALANCED` = {'BTC': 0.0}): the adds-only band for this cluster is **0 pp** instead of 8 — a held crypto sleeve is added to whenever its target rises and is **never trimmed by the tilt**. The 30 % cluster cap still binds, and the pre-existing book-overflow rule (scale the whole book down when the kept weights exceed 100 %) still applies. Every other cluster keeps the 8 pp pin; V1, Growth and Aggressive are unchanged.

### Why

On the P&L section's walk-forward replay the crypto sleeves' **realized P&L since 2026-03-01** was lower under V2 than V1 (Balanced, per $1 at the anchor: V1 **+13.0c**, V2 **+7.4c**; MSTU +9.2c vs +4.6c). The crypto *signals* are identical in V1 and V2 and both held the cluster on the same 33 days — the gap is weight. Stepping the V2 rules in one at a time: V2 universe with V1's allocator rules +13.4c → + 30 % cluster cap +13.2c → **+ adds-only +7.4c** → + fixed split +7.9c. V1 re-sizes daily, so when other sleeves exited and the funded set shrank (16 → 12 sleeves) its cluster grew back to ~31–33 % of the book, while V2's adds-only pin left it at its ~13 % entry size.

### How the split was chosen

A post-hoc study re-divided the *unchanged* V2 Balanced cluster weights over an ordered grid (MSTR ≥ MSTU ≥ BTC ≥ ETH, 5 % steps, all four names, per-sleeve caps respected). The top mix was 50 / 30 / 15 / 5; the proposed 45 / 35 / 15 / 5 would put MSTU at 10.5 % of the book, above Balanced's 10 % 2× cap, so the cap-compliant neighbour **45 / 30 / 20 / 5** was adopted — all 28 Balanced grid mixes beat V2 in both the selection and hold-out windows (3 of 41 in Growth, 0 of 41 in Aggressive, so those keep the tilt split). The adds band was tested as 8 pp (V2), 3 pp, 0 pp (add, never trim) and full daily re-sizing: 0 pp gave the best Balanced result; full re-sizing was close but also trims. Growth showed a 1-pt deeper hold-out drawdown with 0 pp, so only Balanced is changed.

## Caveats

* The crypto sleeves only exist from 2024-03 and the cluster is held on ~10 % of days (about 8–10 trades), so the effect is small in absolute terms and the evidence is consistency across seeds and windows, not size. Four adds-band variants were compared after seeing results (a mild selection effect), and the hold-out is not fully clean: a post-hoc grid study had seen full-sample results.
* A larger average crypto weight means more exposure to the one BTC signal — the concentration the 30 % cluster cap exists to bound. The cap is unchanged.
* "Never trimmed" means never trimmed *by the tilt*: the pre-existing book-overflow rule and the 30 % cluster cap can still scale a held weight down.
* MSTU's history before 2024-09 is the committed OLS-synthetic series.
* Costs are a flat 5 bp on target-weight changes (no spread widening, no drift between rebalances).
* Live effect is nil until a crypto signal fires: the published book holds no crypto sleeve today.
